title: Washington State Reports First Bird Flu Death of the Year
subtitle: Health officials emphasize that the risk to the general public remains low following a recent death linked to dairy cattle exposure.

summary.en: A resident of Yakima County, Washington, has died after contracting bird flu from infected dairy cattle. This marks the first death from the virus in the United States this year. Health officials confirmed that the person had existing health conditions that made them more vulnerable. While three human cases have been identified in the county, authorities stress that the virus does not spread easily between people. The public is advised to avoid contact with sick animals to prevent further infections.
summary.zh: 華盛頓州亞基馬郡一名居民因感染來自受感染乳牛的禽流感後過世。這是今年美國首起因該病毒導致的死亡案例。衛生官員證實，該名人士因本身患有健康問題而更為脆弱。雖然該郡已確認三起人類感染病例，但當局強調病毒不會在人與人之間輕易傳播。建議民眾避免接觸患病動物，以預防進一步感染。

paragraphs.en: A resident of Yakima County, Washington, has died after being hospitalized with a severe illness caused by bird flu. Local health officials announced the news on Sunday, marking the first death from the virus in the United States this year. The individual, whose name and age have not been released to protect their family's privacy, had underlying health conditions that likely made the infection more dangerous.
paragraphs.zh: 華盛頓州亞基馬郡（Yakima County）的一名居民在因禽流感引發嚴重疾病住院後不幸過世。當地衛生官員於週日宣布此消息，這是今年美國首起因該病毒導致的死亡案例。由於需保護家屬隱私，該名人士的姓名與年齡並未公開，但據悉其本身患有潛在健康問題，這可能使其感染後的病情更為危險。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the person was exposed to avian influenza—commonly known as bird flu—at a dairy farm where cattle were infected. Since early October, officials in Yakima County have reported that 33 dairy herds have tested positive for a highly pathogenic, or very dangerous, form of the virus. This specific strain, known as H5N1, has been spreading among wild birds, poultry, and livestock for several years. The situation became a national public health concern in early 2024 when the virus began jumping from birds to dairy cows.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，該名人士是在一處有牛隻感染的乳牛場接觸到禽流感。自十月初以來，亞基馬郡官員通報已有三十三群乳牛檢測出高病原性，亦即極度危險的病毒株。這種被稱為 H5N1 的特定病毒株，已在野生鳥類、家禽與牲畜間傳播多年。二零二四年年初，當病毒開始從鳥類傳播至乳牛時，此情況隨即成為全國性的公共衛生隱憂。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the death, the Yakima Health District confirmed a third human case of bird flu in the county. This person was also exposed to infected dairy cattle but did not require hospitalization and did not experience severe illness. According to Ars Technica, this is the third human death linked to the virus since it began affecting livestock in the United States in March 2024. Previous deaths included an elderly person in Louisiana in early 2025 and another individual in Washington state later that same year.
paragraphs.zh: 除了這起死亡案例外，亞基馬衛生局（Yakima Health District）亦證實該郡出現第三起人類感染禽流感的病例。此人同樣曾接觸受感染的乳牛，但並未住院且未出現嚴重症狀。根據《Ars Technica》報導，這是自二零二四年三月病毒開始影響美國牲畜以來，第三起與該病毒相關的人類死亡案例。先前的死亡案例包括二零二五年年初路易斯安那州的一名長者，以及同年稍晚在華盛頓州的另一名人士。

paragraphs.en: Despite these reports, health authorities are working to calm public fears. Officials from the Yakima Health District and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) have stated that the risk to the general public remains low. They explained that human-to-human transmission—the spread of the virus from one person to another—is extremely rare and has never been documented in the United States. The CDC has recorded 72 human cases across the country since 2024, but they maintain that the virus is primarily a risk for those who work closely with infected animals.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些通報，衛生當局仍致力於平息大眾恐慌。亞基馬衛生局與疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）的官員表示，對一般大眾而言，風險依然很低。他們解釋，人與人之間的傳播——即病毒從一個人傳染給另一個人——極為罕見，且在美國從未有過相關紀錄。自二零二四年以來，疾管中心在全國記錄了七十二起人類感染病例，但他們堅稱該病毒主要對那些與受感染動物密切接觸的工作人員構成風險。

paragraphs.en: STAT News reported that the CDC analyzed the genetic sequence of the virus from the person who died in Washington. Their findings showed no changes that would make the virus spread more easily or cause more severe illness in the general population. Because the virus is present in the environment at certain farms, officials are urging workers to take extra precautions. This includes wearing protective gear, such as masks and gloves, when handling poultry or working near animals that might be sick.
paragraphs.zh: 《STAT News》報導指出，疾管中心分析了該名在華盛頓州過世者的病毒基因序列。研究結果顯示，病毒並未出現使其更容易傳播或對一般大眾造成更嚴重疾病的變異。由於病毒存在於特定農場的環境中，官員呼籲工作人員採取額外預防措施。這包括在處理家禽或在可能患病的動物附近工作時，穿戴口罩與手套等防護裝備。

paragraphs.en: Public health teams are currently working to identify and contact anyone who may have been in close contact with the infected individuals. By monitoring these people for symptoms, officials hope to stop any further spread. Dave Atteberry, the health officer for the Yakima Health District, expressed his condolences to the family of the person who died. He noted that while the outcome is heartbreaking, the current situation does not represent a widespread threat to the average person.
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生團隊目前正致力於識別並聯繫所有可能與受感染者有密切接觸的人員。透過監測這些人的症狀，官員希望阻止病毒進一步擴散。亞基馬衛生局衛生官戴夫·阿特伯里（Dave Atteberry）向逝者家屬表達哀悼。他指出，雖然結果令人心碎，但目前的情況並未對一般民眾構成廣泛威脅。

paragraphs.en: As the investigation continues, the focus remains on dairy farms and the health of those who work there. Experts continue to study the virus to ensure that it does not change in a way that could pose a larger danger to the public. For now, the message from health agencies is clear: the virus is a serious concern for specific groups, but it is not a reason for the general public to panic.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著調查持續進行，焦點仍集中在乳牛場以及當地工作人員的健康狀況。專家持續研究該病毒，以確保其不會發生可能對大眾構成更大危險的變異。目前，衛生機構傳達的訊息很明確：該病毒對特定族群而言是嚴重的隱憂，但一般大眾無需恐慌。

keyTerms.definitionEn: In the context of a virus, moving or spreading from one species to another.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「跳躍」解，此處指病毒跨物種傳染。文中：The situation became a national public health concern in early 2024 when the virus began jumping from birds to dairy cows.

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於描述因果關係，非字面上的「連結」。文中：According to Ars Technica, this is the third human death linked to the virus since it began affecting livestock in the United States in March 2024.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make someone or a group of people feel less worried or anxious.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞（冷靜的），此處作動詞用。文中：Despite these reports, health authorities are working to calm public fears.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To present or constitute a problem, danger, or difficulty.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（姿勢），此處作動詞，後面常接 danger 或 threat。文中：Experts continue to study the virus to ensure that it does not change in a way that could pose a larger danger to the public.

quiz.question: What factor likely contributed to the severity of the victim's illness in Yakima County?

options.A: The victim was elderly and lacked access to modern medical care.
options.B: The victim had pre-existing health conditions that made the infection worse.
options.C: The victim was exposed to a new, mutated strain of H5N1 that is more deadly.
options.D: The victim worked in an environment with poor ventilation and high viral loads.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段最後一句，文中明確指出該名患者患有「underlying health conditions」（潛在健康狀況），這使得感染變得更加危險。選項 A 雖然文中提到過往有老年案例，但並未說明此特定患者的年齡；選項 C 與文章第五段 CDC 的分析矛盾，該分析顯示病毒並未發生使其更致命的變異；選項 D 雖然在邏輯上合理，但文中並未提及該農場的通風狀況。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why are dairy farm workers specifically targeted for health warnings?

options.A: Because they are the only people who have contracted the virus in the United States.
options.B: Because the virus spreads easily between humans in the close quarters of a farm.
options.C: Because the virus is primarily transmitted to humans through direct contact with infected livestock.
options.D: Because they are refusing to wear the protective gear recommended by the CDC.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第二段與第四段，病毒已從鳥類傳播至乳牛，且所有人類病例皆與接觸受感染的家畜有關。文中第四段提到病毒對一般大眾風險低，但對「work closely with infected animals」（與受感染動物密切接觸者）風險較高，因此可推論傳播途徑主要來自接觸受感染的牲畜。選項 A 錯誤，因為一般大眾也有風險；選項 B 與文中「人傳人極其罕見」的敘述直接衝突；選項 D 文中並未提及工人拒絕穿戴防護裝備。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'documented' mean as it is used in the context of human-to-human transmission?

options.A: Officially recorded or proven to have happened.
options.B: Written down in a private medical diary.
options.C: Predicted to occur in the near future.
options.D: Discussed in a public health meeting.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在該句中，「documented」指的是透過科學證據或官方紀錄證實某事發生。在此脈絡下，意指美國境內從未有過人傳人的確診紀錄或科學證據。選項 B 太過侷限於個人日記；選項 C 是錯誤的，因為該詞描述的是過去與現在的狀態，而非預測；選項 D 雖然討論可能涉及紀錄，但「documented」強調的是「證實發生的事實」，而不僅僅是討論的過程。

quiz.question: What is the primary message the health authorities want to convey to the public regarding the recent bird flu death?

options.A: The bird flu virus is evolving rapidly and will soon become a major threat to everyone.
options.B: Dairy farms should be closed immediately to prevent further human infections.
options.C: The virus is a serious issue for high-risk workers, but it is not a widespread threat to the general public.
options.D: The public should panic and avoid all dairy products until further notice.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章多次強調（特別是第四段與最後一段），儘管出現了死亡案例，但 CDC 與衛生官員一致認為對一般大眾的風險仍然很低，且不應感到恐慌。選項 A 與 CDC 的基因分析報告衝突；選項 B 文中並未建議關閉農場，僅建議加強防護；選項 D 與文章結尾「not a reason for the general public to panic」的立場完全相反。
